sources.entry: Marked 2 - This is the Markdown preview with an elegant and powerful set of tools for all writers.

summary.name: Marked 2
summary.one_liner: Marked 2 is a macOS previewer for Markdown and other plain text markups that updates live as you save changes in your editor.
keywords: write in plain text rich formatting
use_cases: Previewing Markdown while writing in another editor
Exporting documents to PDF, Word or HTML
Checking word count, readability and repeated words in manuscripts
Previewing Scrivener, MarsEdit or Fountain documents
summary.what_it_does: Marked watches files edited in any external text editor and refreshes its preview each time the file is saved, scrolling to the most recent edit. It renders Markdown with GitHub Flavored Markdown support and can also work with custom processors for other syntaxes. Documents can be exported as HTML, PDF or Word in a range of styles, and self-contained HTML can be produced with embedded assets. Writing-focused analysis includes word count, reading time, Fog Index, Flesch-Kincaid scores, word repetition and overused-word highlighting. It also offers an automatic table of contents, typeahead search, link validation, and adjustable autoscroll that can serve as a teleprompter.
notable: Live preview that updates on save from any external editor
Advanced writing analysis: readability scores, word repetition and overused-word highlighting
Supports Fountain, CriticMarkup, Scrivener, MarsEdit and book formats like Leanpub
Almost fully keyboard-navigable with Vim-style shortcuts
caveats: Free trial lasts seven days; full version must be purchased via Paddle
The purchased version is the non-sandboxed build
